bugs.short: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: App still crashes on every open after a force stop with a canvas being edited
bugs.creator: WILLY_WU
bugs.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap Swipe Collage on the Launcher
3. Tap the Year-end Recap 「4 photos · 3 pages」 card
4. Tap Use Template
5. Tap the 「+」 of a page-1 frame
6. Select 1 photo
7. Tap Next
8. Tap the filled frame
9. Tap the same frame again
10. Tap Removal on the tool bar
11. Tap Continue
12. Tap Try First
13. Tap ✕ in the Object Removal room
14. Force stop PhotoDirector
15. Launch the APP
16. Tap Swipe Collage on the Launcher
17. Check the result

Result:
The app crashes at once (ClassCastException in SwipeCollageDraftUseCase load), on every later try.
摘要：強制關閉後重開，每次進入 Swipe Collage 都立即閃退。
{20.19.0_swc51_canvas_before_force_stop.jpg} {20.19.0_swc51_crash_dialog.jpg} {20.19.0_swc51_crash_log.txt}

Expect Result:
No crash: 「Continue editing?」 appears and restores the project, or Swipe Collage opens normally.
摘要：不應閃退，應出現「Continue editing?」還原專案或正常進入。

Note:
Device: Google Pixel 8a / Android 16
Spec Link: Swipe Collage PhDM Spec.pdf (PM), leave-notes board (D1-10: 「Continue editing?」 after a kill restores the project)
Related: PHA262026P0147 (same crash; the fix in this build does not stop it); also on Samsung Galaxy S23 (SM-S9110) / Android 16 with this build
<Claude Reviewed>
